veranderings.voor: Op hul sweeftuie het hulle geleer
veranderings.na: Met hul sweeftuie het hulle geleer
veranderings.rede: 'Met' reads more naturally than 'op' for learning a skill by means of the gliders.

veranderings.voor: Met die enjin en sterk wind kon
veranderings.na: Met die enjin en 'n sterk wind kon
veranderings.rede: A single countable wind needs the article here; 'en sterk wind' sounds clipped.

vlae.teks: 'n Sweeftuig sak deur die lug om hom. Hy moet dus eers hoogte kry voordat hy kan gly.
vlae.rede: The glider is 'dit' in the block 'Hul eerste vliegtuig was 'n sweeftuig' but 'hy' here; both are acceptable Afrikaans and the protected 'deur die lug om hom' sits beside both, so I did not change it, but a person may want one pronoun throughout.
